# `nlink-lab scenario`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Run a `scenario` block from a deployed lab's topology.

When it ends, failed or cancelled too, the lab is put back as the scenario found it (impairments, partitions, pair impairments, interfaces it took down), unless the scenario says `keep`.

JSON OUTPUT (with `--json`): the full `ScenarioResult` (steps, actions, assertion outcomes, timings, and `cleanup`: what was put back). Exit 2 when any step or the cleanup fails.

Usage: nlink-lab scenario [OPTIONS] [NAME]

Arguments:
  [NAME]
          Scenario name as declared in the topology (`scenario "name" { … }`). Omit to list the scenarios the lab defines

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

      --bundle <DIR>
          When it fails, keep the lab's failure bundle in `DIR/<lab>/` (see `nlink-lab bundle`)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
